title: Browser sign-in calls
responsibility: Expose the browser-facing authentication endpoints through the supplied API client.

inputs.name: browserAuth.api
inputs.description: API client carrying same-site requests and failures.

outputs.name: browserAuth
outputs.description: Methods for status, login challenge, Google credential submission, email code send/verification, logout and native handoff polling/approval. Credentials and typed codes travel in request bodies; the server determines identity.
